item.title: Sway config
item.description: Migrating to sway/wayland from i3wm/X. This bellow is my sway config. It can be tangled with Org Mode to appropriate locations. See the source of this site. See https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Sway Put a warning at the beginning of the tangled file just to be sure not to forget. # Warning: this config is maintained through Org Mode file. Do not edit directly! # Tangled from site.org Install sudo pacman -S wayland xorg-xwayland sway swaylock swaybg See other sections for the installation of other tools used in this config.
